Human Semantic Decision: When one valid firing resolution discharges one magazine round, exactly 1 unit of magazine ammunition is consumed. For N > 1, ammo transitions N -> N - 1. For N = 1, ammo transitions 1 -> 0, and the canonical ammo-depletion response (FIRING -> IDLE, EXPOSED -> TRANSITIONING_TO_COVERED) applies at the same firing-resolution boundary.
Preconditions: Magazine round consumption requires N >= 1. Invoking consumption when N = 0 is an invalid gameplay transition. Consumption must never produce negative values.
Representation vs Precondition vs Eligibility: Non-negative safe integer is a representation check; N >= 1 is a transition precondition; canFire remains deferred.
Reload boundary: Reaching 0 ammo does not start reload; reload requires fully COVERED posture under GS-004.
Domain API shape is NOT decided by this task (deferred to implementation).
CombatCoordinationSnapshot remains limited to CharacterPostureState and WeaponActionState (MagazineAmmoState is not added).
Zero Domain/Application/Presentation implementation files or tests are modified in T-028.
Historical T-000 through T-026 records and events are preserved without modification.
